deviations.what: A user named with --user who has no recorded Stripe customer is a CommandError, as an unknown user is.
deviations.why: The plan names only the unknown-user error. Silently syncing nothing hides a mistaken name; the error is the more useful answer and costs no behaviour anyone depends on.

deviations.what: The admin shows status through a display method (status_label) rather than the model field, and the price through mvp_payments.money.Money.
deviations.why: A choices field renders a status Stripe adds later as a dash, which breaks Article XV (shown as itself). Money gives the amount with its currency in the right unit.

deviations.what: No get_actions override to remove delete_selected.
deviations.why: Django drops the action from any list whose has_delete_permission is False, and an override without the action_location parameter is deprecated in Django 6.1 while 5.2 is supported. A test covers both the missing control and a posted action.

deviations.what: Admin tests run under tests/urls_with_admin.py; the demo mounts no admin.
deviations.why: The tests need an admin site to reverse; mounting one in the demo was outside the tasks.
T012 needs Stripe to answer with an error message that quotes a key, which the existing helpers cannot produce. Additive only.

deviations.what: The renamed module names logger, http_client, customer_for and from_epoch are described under 'Module names' in docs/reference/stripe-app.md.
deviations.why: The docs gate failed on the first verify run with those four as undocumented public names; underscores are ruled out, so they are documented.

concerns: The completion-report schema allows one story id; this report covers US2, US3, US4 and US5 together and carries US5.

Finding for SC-008: the Stripe SDK's own 'stripe' logger writes the response body at debug and the error message at info. Stripe masks the key it repeats, and the app logs only error types, but a project that enables the 'stripe' logger at those levels logs Stripe's text. Documented in docs/reference/stripe-app.md, not suppressed.
SQLite has no row locks, so the suite cannot prove select_for_update emits FOR UPDATE (carried from US1).
US5 scenario 1 (a demo user subscribes in a real sandbox and the demo records it) is documented but not run; it needs a sandbox account.

Verify was run twice: the first run failed the docs step on four newly public names, the second passed after the docs fix. Final run: conformance, docs, uv:lint, uv:typecheck, uv:test, uv:build all passed.
demo/settings.py keeps its pre-existing _dev_env function; the rename task covered the names the Stripe app introduced.
The demo mounts no Django admin, so the new admin is reachable only in a project that mounts it.
